name: Ardrossan Foodbank
short_description: Trussell Trust foodbank serving Ardrossan and Three Towns area
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network. Provides emergency food parcels and support to local residents in crisis. Referral required.

name: Ardrossan Community Garden
short_description: Community garden with raised beds and greenhouse at Seacoxwell
months: this garden provides growing space for residents and educational workshops for children.

name: Ardrossan Community Fridge
short_description: Community fridge at Irvine Bay Centre reducing food waste
description: Located at Irvine Bay Medical Centre
months: this fridge allows residents to share surplus food and access free items. Open during centre hours.

name: Ardrossan Public Apple Trees
short_description: Apple trees in Ardrossan Cemetery open for public picking
description: Several heritage apple trees in Ardrossan Cemetery are available for public picking in autumn. Planted in memory of local residents.
